module_summary: Cache controller with 5-state FSM, associative lookup, and hit/miss responses.

anchors.name: cur
anchors.why: FSM state register; transitions HOME/PROBE/PUSH/PULL/ACK through cache operations.

anchors.name: keys
anchors.why: Cache tag storage; indexed by sel to check tag match.

anchors.name: words
anchors.why: Cache data storage; indexed by sel to return hit data.

anchors.name: vld
anchors.why: Cache line valid bits; per-line flags gating hit detection.

anchors.name: lat_w
anchors.why: Latches write command; steers to PUSH vs READ path.

anchors.name: lat_d
anchors.why: Latches write data; used for cache update on PUSH.

anchors.name: lat_a
anchors.why: Latches request address; decoded to sel and key.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request valid; gates state machine from HOME.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: CPU request ready; asserted only in HOME state.

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: CPU response valid; asserted in ACK state.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: CPU response data; driven by output buffer.

anchors.name: obuf
anchors.why: Output buffer; holds hit data or filled data for response.

anchors.name: sel
anchors.why: Cache line selector; derived from lat_a for tag/data lookups.

anchors.name: key
anchors.why: Tag from address; compared to k_rd for match detection.

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Tag match signal; gates HIT path when valid and tags match.

anchors.name: fill_go
anchors.why: Fill completion enable; fills cache line on memory ack in PULL.

anchors.name: wr_go
anchors.why: Write completion enable; updates cache on match in PUSH.

groups.name: FSM Controller
groups.description: 5-state FSM managing cache lookup and fill operations.

groups.name: Cache Storage
groups.description: Tag array, data array, and valid bits for cache lines.

groups.name: Address Latching and Decoding
groups.description: Request latches and address decoding to index and tag.

groups.name: Lookup Logic
groups.description: Hit detection and state-dependent gating signals.
